messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up-- scheduling a short rolling maintenance in us-west2 tonight 02:00-02:30 UTC. Goal: graceful driver soft-restart + NVMe queue defrag on rack A9 cohorts 3..5. Target: shared pools only; dedicated and regulatory-tagged tenants excluded.

Dan: TL;DR plan?

Priya: Steps: cordon one cohort at a time, drain tenants in small batches, enable io-throttle to 55% while draining, perform driver soft-restart, wait for KV-cache reseed, uncordon. Stagger cohorts by 7m. Expected user impact: brief p99 blips ~1-3% for interactive; no full outage.

Priya: Runbook snippet: ``./infra cordon --region us-west2 --rack A9 --cohort 3`` then ``./ops drain --cohort A9-3 --batch 6 --stagger 7m --exclude-tag dedicated`` then ``curl -X POST https://infra.api/ops/throttle -d '{"cohort":"A9-3","io_pct":55}'``

Kai: Capacity note: shared baseline ~70% util. We can accept ~5 GPUs rotation concurrently. With batch 6/concurrency 1 and 7m stagger should be within safe margins. If queueing >5min, pause.

Dan: Rollback criteria?

Priya: Abort if sustained p99 >8% for 10m or error rate >0.8%. Rollback commands: ``./ops job pause JOB-6199998888`` ``./infra uncordon --region us-west2 --rack A9 --cohort 3`` and remove throttle via API. I'll tag @oncall and open rollback ticket.

infra-bot: Maintenance job scheduled: JOB-6199998888-DRIVER-SOFTRESTART (start 6199998800, window 30m).

Kai: Cost impact: small overlap/backfill ~2-4% extra GPU-hours for the half-hour window; ballpark $2k. Will post exact after run.

Dan: I'll run the canary and watch p99, GPU temps, and NVMe SMART. If temps or SMART errors persist after two cohorts, escalate to hardware.

ops-bot: Deploy lock set for us-west2 cohorts 01:50-02:40 UTC.

Priya: I'll post start/mid/end updates to #incidents. Ping me immediately if latency or error spikes look off. Starting at 02:00 UTC unless objections. :hourglass:
